channel_policy: new projects resolve the current studio-main HEAD then pin that exact commit for the project lifetime; recovery is only for continuation, never a prerequisite for a brand-new project
host_capability_policy: discover connector functions when they are not preloaded, then detect actual current-session GitHub connector, native web, artifact/file download and local execution capabilities before choosing a bootstrap path; shell/container networking is never a substitute for native web or connector access
project_router_policy: Project Instructions are a compact routing/bootstrap/UI-entry contract only; detailed workflow, template, enforcement, regression and host behavior must be loaded from the pinned Studio repository commit
static_ui_filename_policy: versioned timestamp+content-digest filenames; static_ui/latest.json points to current surface; legacy fixed HTML aliases are removed on rebuild
